title: Generate All Product Bundles
real_world_story: An e-commerce platform wants to explore every possible combination of a small set of products so that different product bundles can be considered for recommendations.

real_world_connection.input_represents: A small collection of available products
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Generating all subsets of the product collection

problem_statement: Given N distinct product IDs, generate all possible subsets of the products, including the empty set and the complete set.
task: Generate the power set of the given product IDs.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N distinct integers representing product IDs.
output_format: Print all possible subsets, one subset per line. The order of subsets does not matter.

examples.explanation: Three products produce 2^3 = 8 possible combinations, including the empty set.

expected_algorithm.name: Power Set
expected_algorithm.reason: Each product can either be included or excluded from a bundle, producing all possible subsets.

hint: For every product, consider two choices: include it or exclude it.
Continue this decision for every product.
Each complete sequence of choices forms one possible bundle.
real_world_takeaway: Power sets can help generate possible product bundles when the number of products is small.
